entities.title: Godot client
entities.summary: The Godot 4.7 project that is the game: the 3D table and pieces, the screens, and games online, against the computer and in replay.
entities.purpose: One scene (scenes/main.tscn) runs Main; Api and Sfx are autoloads. The rules are chess/, the scripts scripts/, the page the web export runs in web_shell/, and the GDScript tests tests/. The Web preset exports it single-threaded with the Compatibility (WebGL 2) renderer.
boundaries: The Worker, the page bridge and Stockfish are outside the project; the client reaches them over HTTP, a WebSocket and JavaScriptBridge.
fonts/ holds the four font files and their SIL OFL licences; they are assets, not documented here.
